scope.name: Scope
scope.input_contract: Use exact ranked ValueRank model IDs and current first-party provider sources; keep published plan data distinct from end-user reports.
scope.verification: Scope lists 13 ranked models, seven providers, the strict user-report window, source boundaries, inclusions and exclusions.
scope.validation: Manual scope check against current project roster and user constraints.
scope.repair: No model substitutions; Go is excluded as a verified route because current first-party page does not establish Codex eligibility.

plan.name: Plan
plan.input_contract: Search official plan, support, and API sources for each first-party provider; log exact query and direct pages.
plan.verification: Seven provider branches, exact identity checks, source-count thresholds, critique cycles, and package validators are documented.
plan.validation: Built-in-browser-only restriction and Ultradeep source threshold are explicit.
plan.repair: No external browser, web.run, raw HTTP, or search API was used.

retrieve.name: Retrieve
retrieve.input_contract: Use first-party sources as factual evidence and search pages only for discovery; preserve exact URLs, model IDs, pricing, windows, and dates.
retrieve.verification: Twenty-eight first-party provider documents and one local roster record were entered, with direct URLs and evidence mappings.
retrieve.validation: The 30-source target was not reached; 15-minute time-based triage had elapsed. Average credibility is 100 from primary provider/project sources. The 40-source maximum was respected.
retrieve.repair: Focused loopbacks verified Kimi's conflicting official reset text, exact Kimi K3 ID, and Alibaba's qwen3.8-max API page. Gaps with no published conversion remain explicit.

triangulate.name: Score / Triangulate
triangulate.input_contract: Join exact ranked ID, plan product, usage unit, and API model independently; never infer a match from a similar string.
triangulate.verification: Exact-ID mismatches, plan/API product boundaries, currency differences, resets, and conversion inputs were cross-checked.
triangulate.validation: Only GLM-5.3 has a bounded first-party plan/API conversion; all other unavailable equivalents are N/C.
triangulate.repair: OpenAI 6.1 Sol, Google app/ API, xAI 4.7 plan, Kimi tier mapping, and Alibaba credit conversions were excluded from inferred matches.

outline.name: Outline / Refine
outline.input_contract: Map every major report finding to evidence and package tables before synthesis.
outline.verification: Outline enumerates summary, seven provider branches, 13-model matrix, plan table, calculations, limitations, and handoff.
outline.validation: Report sections and supporting package files match the outline.
outline.repair: Added explicit plan/API product boundary and local currency treatment.

synthesize.name: Synthesize
synthesize.input_contract: Write source-cited claims using provider statements as provider claims, with N/C for missing conversions.
synthesize.verification: Report covers all seven providers and states every major tariff, quota, tier, identity mismatch, and remaining blocker.
synthesize.validation: Each package claim references evidence IDs; inline source citations link to direct first-party pages.
synthesize.repair: Temporary promotions and regional prices are separated from steady-state use and other currencies.

critique.name: Adversarial Review
critique.input_contract: Challenge identity, source authority, allowance arithmetic, currency, temporary terms, and evidence-class leakage.
critique.verification: Three cycles produced explicit findings and retrieval loopbacks; repair decisions and residual limitations are recorded.
critique.validation: No unsupported API-variant transfer, temporary promotion annualization, or provider-to-user-claim promotion remains.
critique.repair: Kimi and Qwen direct pages were reopened; GLM range method was recomputed and bounded.

refine.name: Verify / Refresh
refine.input_contract: Apply critique repairs; verify exact files, ledgers, arithmetic, and citations.
refine.work_product: research_report.md; model_coverage.csv; plan_allowances.csv; calculations.csv; validation logs
refine.verification: Focused browser rereads confirmed Kimi pricing and windows, Kimi K3 identity, Qwen plan tiers, Qwen API rates, and OpenAI local plan price.
refine.validation: Silver Bullet validators and deterministic package crosswalk pending execution.
refine.repair: Any validation defects will be repaired before marking this phase complete.

package.name: Package
package.input_contract: Package decision, handoff, validated artifacts, and a nine-phase rollup with honest limitations.
package.verification: All planned source and synthesis artifacts exist; final validation results still need recording.
package.validation: Pending report, citation, claim-support, phase-gate, and arithmetic crosswalk checks.
package.repair: Update this rollup and handoff with exact results after validators run.

limitation: The optional search CLI was unavailable. Silver Bullet phases were followed manually with direct Codex in-app browser retrieval; the documented slash command was not invoked. The nominal 30-source target was not reached before the 15-minute triage threshold, but the scoped official sources and remaining gaps are recorded.
